# Harshil Patel

> Full-Stack Developer, Mobile App Developer, AI Tooling Engineer, and Content Creator (@guywithblack350). B.Tech Computer Science student at IIIT Vadodara.

## Bio & Overview
Harshil Patel is a full-stack developer and computer science student at IIIT Vadodara (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Vadodara). He specializes in React, TypeScript, Node.js, Firebase, Svelte 5, Android (Kotlin), PWA, and AI API integrations (Gemini, Claude, Ollama).

Alongside software engineering, Harshil is an automotive content creator operating under the handle **@guywithblack350** across Instagram and YouTube, generating 22M+ views and collaborating with automotive and lifestyle brands.

## Featured Software Projects

- **PayMatrix** (https://www.harshilpatel.co.in/projects/paymatrix)
  - *Type*: AI-Powered Group Expense & Debt Settlement Platform
  - *Tech Stack*: React 19, Firebase, Tailwind CSS, Gemini Vision API
  - *Highlights*: Scans physical bills with Gemini Vision AI, calculates minimal debt settlement graphs, native UPI deep-linking, real-time group sync.
  - *Live App*: https://pay-matrix.vercel.app/
  - *GitHub*: https://github.com/Marshmellow31/PayMatrix

- **ESP32 Smart AC** (https://www.harshilpatel.co.in/projects/esp32-smart-ac)
  - *Type*: Hardware / Firmware / IoT Smart AC Controller
  - *Tech Stack*: ESP32, C++ / Arduino, PlatformIO, Vanilla JS PWA
  - *Highlights*: Turn a standard Samsung split AC into a smart AC for ~₹600 via 38 kHz IR, on-device web app PWA, sleep curves, live energy/cost tracking, and Alexa/Google Voice control.
  - *GitHub*: https://github.com/Marshmellow31/Smart-AC-Dashboard

## Technical Skills & Expertise

- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C++, Java, Dart, Kotlin, SQL
- **Frontend**: React 19, Next.js, Svelte 5, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, HTML5, CSS3
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, Express, Firebase (Firestore, Auth), MySQL, REST APIs, Vercel
- **Mobile & Embedded**: Android Native (Kotlin), Flutter, PWA, Capacitor, ESP32 (C++/Arduino)
- **AI & ML**: Gemini Vision API, Claude API, Ollama (Local LLMs), Whisper Speech-to-Text, Embeddings
- **Tools**: Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Docker, Vitest, ESLint, Oxlint

  - *URL*: https://www.harshilpatel.co.in/blog/esp32-smart-ac
